exposure: nulliparous term singleton vertex (NTSV) cesarean birth
outcome: nulliparous term singleton vertex (NTSV) cesarean birth
cohort: Mother-infant dyads (N=955,904) from birth and fetal death certificates linked to hospital discharge data across 266 hospitals in Michigan, Oregon, Pennsylvania, and South Carolina from 2016-2018.
finding: The study observed minimal correlations among various perinatal quality measures, especially when aggregated beyond individual outcomes.
mod_finding: NTSV cesarean birth was included as a maternal quality measure, and its correlation with other measures was examined.
